title: E0.4.3 Source-Universe Migration, Purpose Audit & Thin-Slice Candidate Lock
authority: Nutrition Data Foundation D0-D2 + NDS-R1 v0.1

input_lineage.legacy_sampling_role: Paper C source-level evidence-production measurement universe; not a NutritionDecisionReference universe

purpose_overlap_audit.rule: 98 locked-evaluation overlaps are quarantine-only; 24 Calibration24 overlaps are calibration-only; neither class is D1 reference-development input.

source_identity_recoverability.interpretation: SourceArtifact/StudyIdentity/source-text lineage is broadly recoverable, but same-study multi-report records must remain dependency-linked rather than counted as independent evidence.

temporal_audit.note: Publication-date compatibility alone is insufficient. Corrected/living/version-sensitive records require reconstruction of the exact version available at the eventual Paper 1 evidence cutoff.

scientific_scope_audit.legacy_mining_design: broad PubMed family queries with capped returned sets plus coverage repair, optimized for source-level challenge coverage
mismatch: E0.4.3 was optimized for Paper C extraction/verification stress coverage, not Paper 1 decision relevance.
55/208 remaining records are external biomedical/public-health stress candidates and require explicit EQ relevance justification.
Legacy PubMed universe does not guarantee current formal guideline/official nutrition recommendation coverage.
Official nutrient/safety reference classes required by some Paper 1 EQs are not guaranteed by the legacy source-family design.
No legacy eligibility state transfers to D1 ScientificClaim qualification.

first_thin_slice.open_gap: formal guideline/official recommendation + targeted primary evidence acquisition and semantic qualification

next_stage.title: Demand-Driven Scientific Question Intake, Knowledge-Need Contract & First R1/P1 Thin-Slice Selection
actions: select an active NDS-R1 or NDS-P1 scientific need
derive ScientificQuestion and KnowledgeNeed objects from that need
acquire or reuse sources under purpose, provenance, temporal and dependency controls
construct the first demand-driven scientific knowledge thin slice without legacy EQ authority

superseded_findings: legacy 31-EQ registry as current D1 scope
old Paper 1 candidate cutoff as current P1 cutoff
A1 EvidenceQuestion-registry migration as next stage
